property_summary: Calling AdjustDifficulty(amount) on the correct contract always sets the stored difficulty to the provided amount (and emits that value), whereas the mutant sets difficulty to 0 regardless of the provided amount; thus for some fuzzed amount the stored difficulty after the call will differ (amount != 0) and the mutant will violate the rule.
change_summary: Replace setting difficulty with setting to zero (assign 0) so AdjustDifficulty changes stored difficulty value differently.
